extracted.stage: Ongoing financial remedy proceedings, hearing listed, heading to settlement or trial
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Lockwood Legal LLP enquires about £49,000 of funding for a client's representation in ongoing financial remedy proceedings where the matrimonial pot is around £391,000 and a hearing is listed for 16 November.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client regarding funding for her financial remedy proceedings. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court in which the proceedings are issued, details of the assets said to make up the £391,000 pot and how they are held, and the nature of the hearing listed for 16 November. It would also help to have a costs estimate or budget supporting the £49,000 figure, together with your client's details and confirmation of your firm's involvement. We will review the information once received and come back to you with any further questions. Nothing in this message should be taken as an indication of whether funding is available or on what terms.
